address: 321 Vo Van Tan Street, Ban Co Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 72407, Vietnam
bio: Established in 1995, Cô Liêng serves up a modest take on Southern Vietnamese cuisine. The main draw is the charcoal-grilled bò lá lốt (minced beef wrapped in betel leaves) that features perfect savoury-sweet flavour. They also serve rice vermicelli bundles (bánh hỏi with grilled meat)....
